scope: Additive Stage A DRIV3R candidate-contract questions. Existing frozen and historical question objects remain unchanged. Implementation, actual execution and owner acceptance are distinct.

questions.query: How does S1-2B-DRIV3R Stage A reuse the agent-painter foundation without taking over the four training lanes?
facts: The independent #570 candidate starts from qualified #569 source2a565 and accepted mainac0d; #568's four generative painter lanes retain ownership.
DRIV3R selects its own next bounded host-proposed action, separately from #568's optional d1 post-proposal action-veto study.
The existing compiler, native Art authority and runtime verifier are reused; no production-default inference or material-law change is introduced.

questions.query: Which resident d1 backend and question types does the DRIV3R Stage A controller actually support?
facts: The pinned official Q8 GGUF uses llama.cpp b11960/v0.8.0 through /v1/systemone in a resident CPU process, not chat completions.
The Stage A adapter supports ordinary single choice and rejects unsupported fields including multiple.
Named questions assess the same input state; their answers do not automatically feed into one another.
Raw candidate probabilities and confidence are retained; no application calibration or reference-model probability parity is presumed.

questions.query: Can a DRIV3R model decision write arbitrary coordinates or bypass native permissions, and what proves actual painting?
facts: The model chooses a stable candidate ID; the host owns exact operations, material, focus, budgets, freshness and Stop authority.
The native harness mounts the existing Workbench and verifies receipts against original full-World and crop material readbacks.
Material-derived PNGs are not framebuffer screenshots, and model choices or success flags alone do not establish native mutation.
Offline record validation and fresh native replay are distinct checks.

questions.query: What can trigger heavyweight DRIV3R Stage A qualification, and does completion authorize Stage B training or scheduled workers?
facts: Only manual dispatch or an explicit qualification-request change on the dedicated branch enters heavyweight work; ordinary PR updates run cheap offline tests.
Each A1-A8 gate requires actual source-qualified evidence and is reported PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL or BLOCKED.
Stage A ends at the Draft/HOLD owner checkpoint; Stage B/C, training, schedules, production defaults and merge are not automatically authorized.
Research artifact publication does not itself establish acceptance.
